page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. The instance is provisioned with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its substantial bundled local storage, consisting of 94,489 GB of HDD storage. This massive storage capacity is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance runs on a KVM hypervisor and does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to the use of HDD storage instead of SSDs, this instance is optimized for high-capacity sequential storage rather than high-IOPS random access workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation and large local storage capacity offer high resource density for big data processing, distributed file systems, and cold data archiving. It is well-suited for MapReduce jobs, log processing, and large-scale data warehousing where massive storage volume is prioritized over low-latency disk access.
